{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"d protected or compaction-immune. A source's `pinned`, `protected`, or `compaction_immune` metadata controls retention only after the s"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"ource is relevant, current, permitted, and admitted. It does not force injection. Mandatory system/runtime kernel content remains manda"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"tory by its owner contract, not because an unadmitted source self-labels as immune.\n\n`RuntimePolicySnapshot`, `PromptCapsule`, and `C"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"ontextReceipt` are bounded compilation inputs/outputs. The `ContextReceipt` records exact source/provenance refs, admitted and omitted "}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"block IDs, on-demand handles, byte/token estimates, truncation/compaction reasons, selected schema identities, policy/permission snapsh"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"ot refs, and `context_epoch_id`; it explains the compile but grants no execution authority.\n\nPacket Admission proves final packet str"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"ucture and obligation coverage; Permissions and FileSafe separately prove their owner decisions. `ProviderDispatchAdmissionService` con"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"sumes those current decisions plus the exact final provider-visible bytes, structured-attachment manifest, route/model/account/transfor"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"m identity, run/node/attempt identity, current resource-policy admission, and relevant generations. It emits the sole single-use `Provi"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"derDispatchAdmissionReceipt`. No separate `PacketAdmissionReceipt`, `FileSafeGuardReceipt`, `ImmutableDispatchIntent`, or `ProviderRequ"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"estPermit` family is created here. The provider adapter sends the exact receipt-bound bytes rather than reconstructing the request from"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":" mutable inputs. An exact retry may reuse the same rendered bytes, but because the receipt is single-use, each network attempt obtains "}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"a fresh current receipt; any changed byte or binding also reruns the owning decisions.\n"}
